headline: Audemars Piguet's five new watches
stop_reason: No verified photo for the named releases. The Robb Report page redirects to a paywall-style gate (tollbit), so it was not read. The Gadgeteer (6 Nov 2026) gives references, USD prices and 2 Nov 2026 date for the three Supersonneries, and its product images are not loadable by the photo tool (only a wide banner returned). audemarspiguet.com product pages gave no product image in earlier attempts; Wikimedia Commons has nothing. The two Code 11.59 stone-dial models (77410BA.OO.A604CR.01, 77410OR.OO.A001CR.01) have only CHF prices from WatchAdvice (23 Nov 2026), no USD price or release date, and one outlet. Per house rule, no release named without a dated price and a loaded permitted photo. Next step: find a verified release from a permitted brand, or get AP press images supplied by the owner.
